invoicePayLocation.description: This field indicates where invoices from this supplier site or partner are paid - at the store (S) or centrally through corporate accounting (C).

invoiceReceiveLocation.description: This field indicates where invoices from this supplier site or partner are received - at the store (S) or centrally through corporate accounting (C).

comments.description: This field contains any miscellaneous comments associated with the supplier or partner.

defaultItemLeadTime.description:
This field holds the default lead time for the supplier site. The lead time is the time the supplier needs between receiving an order and having the order ready to ship. This value will be defaulted to item/supplier relationships.

Number(4,0)

dunsNumber.description: The Dun and Bradstreet number of the supplier.

dunsLocation.description: The Dun and Bradstreet number of the location of the supplier.

defaultPricingControl.description: Indicates the default value of the pricing control attribute at the supplier site level when supplier-controlled pricing for Consignment/Concession ownership model is used within the Merchandising suite of solutions. Valid values are: R - Retailer, S - Supplier.

generateConsignmentOrderInd.description: This field will allow specification of whether Merchandising is required to generate POs against consignment sales. Valid values are: 'Y' - MFCS will create PO, 'N' - POs will get created externally. If supplier parent, this is defaulted to Y. If supplier site and field is null, this is defaulted to Y.

generateSelfInvoicingInd.description: This field will allow specification of whether self-invoicing needs to be done for consignment purchases or if vendor will send invoices to be matched. Valid values are: 'Y' - MFCS will create invoice, 'N' - Invoice will get created by vendor. If supplier parent, this is defaulted to Y. If supplier site and field is null, this is defaulted to Y.

paymentSiteInd.description: Indicates if the supplier site or partner is a payment site used for invoice payment.

nominationFlag1.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 1, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 1 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inDuty.description: If Import Management is enabled in Merchandising (i. e. system_options. import_ind = Y), the inDuty flag is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in total duty.

nominationFlag3.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 3, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 3 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inExpense.description: The inExpense flag is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in total expenses.

inAlc.description: The inALC flag is used for cost components where the retailer does not expect to receive an actual value for the charge via an obligation or customs entry. The inALC flag allows the value of the cost component to be included in ALC via direct nomination and indicates to the system that the estimated value on the order should be used as the actual value as well because no other actual will be provided.

Number(10,0)

daysUntilExpiry.description:
Indicates how long the calling solution wants Merchandising to retain the reservation. After this many days, the reservation will be released allowing these numbers to be used for other purposes. This is required and must be a value greater than 0. The max number of days is configurable using Item Service configuration.

Number(10,0)

Number(10,0)

example: Input location is not a valid store or warehouse. Input location is 1531.

items.description: List of errors identified during business data processing of the request.

item.description: The transaction level or below transaction level item for which status update is requested.

location.description:
The location at which item status will be updated. Valid location can be a store, physical warehouse or virtual warehouse.

description.description: Request description.

deleteFlag.description: Indicate if the request is to be deleted. Valid values are Y - Yes and N - No.

details.description: Collection of status/update dates on which the new status will be updated. The maximum number of the status/update dates allowed is 999.

itemLocations.description: Collection of item/locations for which the status updates are requested. The maximum number of the items/locations allowed is 999.

This contains the replenishment pack, which will be used to fulfill the demand of the
associated item.

pickPriority.description:
Contains the pick priority for the substitute item. 
If there are multiple substitute items for a main item, then the pick priority will determine the order in which the substitute items will fulfill the store's demand.

item.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the main item. This item must exist as a main sku on the sub_items_head table.

locationHierarchyLevel.description: The corresponding ID based on the specified level of the organizational hierarchy. Valied values are codes from code_type 'GRTA'.

hierarchy.description: The level of the organizational hierarchy used for item-location relationships to add substitute item.

fillPriority.description: This contains the fill priority for the main item. This field applies only to Warehouses.

useSales.description: This indicates whether substitute items will be used in calculating the maximum stock for the floating-point replenishment method.

useStock.description:

when determining the locations need for the main item.  When set Yes (‘Y’), the substitute item stock can
be used to fulfil a locations warehouse demands for the main item.

useForecastSales.description: This indicates whether the substitute item be used to determine the required stock at a given location when a forecasting replenishment method is used for the main item.

hierarchyValue.description:
Valid ID for a chain, area, region, district, store or warehouse given based on the  hierarchy Level.

Number(10,0)

primarySupplier.description:
The primary supplier for the item at the location. If not populated, this will default from the primary supplier on the ITEM_SUPPLIER table.

Number(10,0)

primaryCountry.description: The primary country for the item at the location. If not populated on a create message this will default from the primary country on the ITEM_SUPP_COUNTRY table.

localItemDescription.description: Local description for the item at the location. If not populated on the message this will default from the ITEM_MASTER table.

status.description: The status of the item at the location.

storeOrderMultiple.description: The unit type of the item shipped from the warehouse to the location. Valid values are C (cases), I (inners), and E (eaches). Eaches will default if left null on a create message.

receiveAsType.description: The unit in which the warehouse will receive goods. Valid values are E (eaches) and P (pack). This field only applies to buyer packs. If the item is not a buyer pack this field should be null.

taxableInd.description: Indicates if the item is taxable at the location. Valid values are 'Y' and 'N'. If not populated on the message it will default to 'Y'.

ti.description:
Number of shipping units (cases) that make up one tier of a pallet. Multiply TI x HI to get total number of cases for a pallet.

Number(12,0)

hi.description:
Number of tiers that make up a complete pallet (height). Multiply TI x HI to get total number of cases for a pallet.

Number(12,0)

dailyWastePercent.description:
Average percentage lost from inventory on a daily basis due to natural wastage.

Number(12,4)

localShortDescription.description: The local short description of the item. Will default to the item's short description. Will be downloaded to the POS.

uinType.description: This attribute will contain the type of the unique identification number (UIN) used to identify instances of the item at the location. Valid values for this attribute should be user-definable on the Merchandising code tables. This attribute should be nullable.

uinLabel.description: This attribute will contain the label for the UIN when displayed in Store Inventory Operations. Valid values should be user-definable on the Merchandising code tables. This attribute should be nullable but a value is required when a UIN Type is specified.

captureTime.description: This attribute will indicate when the UIN should be captured for an item during transaction processing. There are 2 valid values for this field which should be stored on the Merchandising code tables: Sale and Store Receiving. This attribute should be nullable.

externalUinInd.description: This Yes/No indicator indicates if UIN is being generated in the external system (e. g. SIM). This value will always be N (no) when the Capture Time attribute is set to Sale.

sourceMethod.description: Determines the source method for a requested item at a store. Valid values: 'W'(warehouse) and 'S'(supplier), default value is 'S'.

sourceWarehouse.description:
If the source_method is 'W', this field contains the source warehouse for fulfilling item requests at a store.

Number(10,0)

unitCost.description:
The current corporate unit cost for the item in the location's currency. This field will only be used to establish the item supplier country loc unit cost; it cannot be modified.

Number(20,4)

purchaseType.description: This contains a code to indicate whether the item is normal merchandise (i. e. owned by the retailer), consignment stock or a concession item. Valid values are 0 - Owned, 1 - Consignment, 2 - Concession.

calculationBasis.description: This indicates if the cost for the consignment/concession item will be managed either based on cost per unit or as a percentage of retail. Valid values are C - Cost per Unit, P - Purchase Rate.

purchaseRate.description:
This column contains the percentage of the retail price which will determine the cost paid to the supplier for a consignment or concession item.

Number(12,4)

pricingControl.description:
This indicates whether the price for the consignment/concession item will be managed by supplier or by retailer when supplier-controlled pricing for Consignment/Concession ownership model is used within the Merchandising suite of solutions. Valid values are:
R - Retailer
S - Supplier

If no value is provided for consignment/concession purchase types, this will be defaulted from item/supplier/country of sourcing /location if purchase type is Consignment/Concession at item/supplier/ country of sourcing/location level. If purchase type is Owned at item/supplier/country of sourcing/location level, then this will be defaulted from item/supplier/country of sourcing if purchase type is Consignment/Concession at item/supplier/country of sourcing level. If purchase type is Owned at item/supplier/country of sourcing level, then this will be defaulted based on Default Pricing Control at supplier site level.

promotableInd.description: This field will indicates,if the item can be included on promotions or not.

rfidInd.description: This indicates if the item is RFID tagged or not. Valid values are Yes (Y) and No (N).

ticketMeasureOfAnEach.description:
Size of an each in terms of the uom_of_price. For example 12 oz. Used in ticketing.

Number(12,4)

ticketPerCount.description:
Size to be used on the ticket in terms of the uom_of_price. For example, if the user wants the ticket to have the label print the price per ounce, this value would be 1. If the user wanted the price per 100 grams this value would be 100. Used in ticketing.

Number(12,4)

ticketUom.description: Unit of measure that will be used on the ticket for this item.

primaryVariant.description: This field is used to address sales of PLUs (i. e. above transaction level items) when inventory is tracked at a lower level (i. e. UPC). This field will only contain a value for items one level higher than the transaction level.

primaryCostPack.description: This field contains an item number that is a simple pack containing the item in the item column for this record. If populated, the cost of the future cost table will be driven from the simple pack and the deals and cost changes for the simple pack.

inboundHandlingDays.description:
This field indicates the number of inbound handling days for an item at a warehouse type location.

Number(2,0)

rangedInd.description: This column determines if the location is ranged intentionally by the user for replenishment/selling or incidentally ranged by the RMS programs when item is not ranged to a specific location on the transaction.

costingLocation.description:
Numeric identifier of the costing location for the franchise store. This field may contain a store or a warehouse.

Number(10,0)

sellingPhaseStartDate.description:
It is used to determine the timing of the generation of markdown recommendation, which will occur x weeks after the start of this phase.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

updSellDateOnStOrdRcpt.description: This indicates whether or not to update the Selling Phase Start Date for the item/loc when a purchase order of this item is received at the store.

updSellDateOnWh2stRcpt.description: This indicates whether or not to update the Selling Phase Start Date for the item/loc when a warehouse to store transfer/allocation of this item is received at the store.

updSellDateOnSt2stRcpt.description: This indicates whether or not to update the Selling Phase Start Date for the item/loc when a store to store transfer of this item is received at the store.

minUnitsForSellDateReset.description:
This field contains the minimum shipped quantity of an item on a transfer/allocation that will trigger the resetting of the Selling Phase Start Date. This value is only used if either of the Set Selling Start Date upon Receipt of a Warehouse to Store Transfer/Allocation or Set Selling Start Date upon Receipt of a Store to Store Transfer are set to Yes (Y).

Number(12,4)

mfgSugRetailInclTax.description:
This field holds the tax-inclusive Manufacturer Suggested Retail in local currency and in item’s standard UOM. It is used when default_tax_type is GTS or SVAT.

Number(20,4)

mfgSugRetailExclTax.description:
This field holds the tax-exclusive Manufacturer Suggested Retail in local currency and in item’s standard UOM. It is used when default_tax_type is SALES.

Number(20,4)

postingClassifier.description: 'Contains a classifier that will be used to segregate the sales posting of the item-loc combination to various GL accounts. Valid values are user-definable on the RMS code tables under code_type 'POCL'.

This collection is treated as a single group and should include all named flexible attributes for the business entity. If any configured named attribute is missing from the input collection, its value will be set to NULL

launchDate.description:
The date the item should first be sold at the location. Value will be downloaded to the POS. No internal processing occurs from this field.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

quantityKeyOptions.description: Determines whether the qty key on a POS should be used for this item at the location. Valid values are in the code_type 'RPO'. Current values include 'R - required', 'P - Prohibited', and 'O - Optional'. Additional values can be added to the code type

manualPriceEntry.description: Determines whether the price can/should be entered manually on a POS for this item at the location. Valid values are in the code_type 'RPO'. Current values include 'R - required', 'P - Prohibited', and 'O - Optional'. Additional values can be added.

depositCode.description: Indicates whether a deposit is associated with this item at the location. Values are in the code_type 'DEPO'. The only processing in Merchandising is downloading it to the POS. Examples are None (NONE), Maine - 0.10 (ME2) and Maine - 0.05 (ME1).

foodStampInd.description: Indicates whether the item is approved for food stamps at the location. This value will be downloaded to the POS.

wicInd.description: Indicates whether the item is approved for WIC at the location. This value will be downloaded to the POS.

proportionalTarePercent.description:
For items sold by weight, this is the proportion of the total weight of a unit of an item that is packaging.

Number(12,4)

fixedTareValue.description:
Holds the weight of the packaging in items sold by weight at the location; i. e. if the tare item is bulk candy, this is weight of the bag and twist tie). The only processing Merchandising does is to download it to POS.

Number(12,4)

fixedTareUom.description: Holds the unit of measure value associated with the tare value. The only processing Merchandising does involving the fixed tare value and UOM is downloading it to the POS. Fixed tare is not subtracted from items sold by weight when sales are uploaded to Merchandising, etc

rewardEligibleInd.description: Holds whether the item is legally valid for various types of bonus point/award programs at the location. This value will be downloaded to the POS.

nationalBrandCompetitorItem.description: Holds the nationally branded item to which you would like to compare the current item. This nationally branded item must exist as an item in Merchandising (i. e. on the item_master table).

returnPolicy.description: The return policy for the item at the location. Valid values are in the code_type 'RETP'. This value will be downloaded to the POS. Examples are All returns accepted (ALL), Customer ID needed for return (ID) and Manager approval needed for return (MNGR).

stopSaleInd.description: Indicates that sale of the item should be stopped immediately at the location (i. e. in case of recall etc). This value will be downloaded to the POS.

electronicMarketClubs.description: Code for the marketing clubs to which the item belongs at the location. Valid values are in the code_type 'MTKC'. Examples are Baby Club (B), Baby/Family Clubs (BF) and Deli Club (D).

reportCode.description: Code to determine which reports the location should run. Values are in the code type REPC (Report Code). Examples are All Locations Reports(ALL) and  No Location Report (NO).

requiredShelfLifeOnSelection.description:
Holds the required shelf life for an item on selection in days. This field is not required. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it.

Number(4,0)

requiredShelfLifeOnReceipt.description:
Holds the required shelf life for an item on receipt in days. This field is not required. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it for processing

Number(4,0)

investmentBuyShelfLife.description:
The Investment Buy-specific shelf life for the item/location.

Number(4,0)

storeReorderableInd.description: A code (Y or N) to indicate whether the store may re-order the item. Will default to N. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems.

rackSize.description: Indicates the rack size that should be used for the item. Valid values for the field are in the code_type 'RACK'. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate to external systems. Examples are large (L), Medium (M) and Small (S).

fullPalletItem.description: A code (Y or N) to indicate whether a store must reorder an item in full pallets only. Will default to N. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate to external systems.

inStoreMarketBasket.description: The in store market basket code for this item/location. Valid values for the field are in the code_type 'STMB'. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems. Examples are A item at this loc (A), B item at this loc (B) and C item at this loc (C).

storageLocation.description: Holds the current storage location or bin number for the item at the location. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it for processing.

alternateStorageLocation.description: Holds the preferred alternate storage location or bin number for the item at the location. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it for processing

returnableInd.description: This field will contain a value of 'Y'es when the item can be returned to the location,

refundableInd.description: This field will contain a value of 'Y'es when the item is refundable at the location.

backOrderInd.description: This field will contain a value of 'Y'es when the item can be back ordered to the location.

returnPolicy.description: The return policy for the item at the location. Valid values are in the code_type 'RETP'. This value will be downloaded to the POS. Examples are All returns accepted (ALL), Customer ID needed for return (ID) and Manager approval needed for return (MNGR).

stopSaleInd.description: Indicates that sale of the item should be stopped immediately at the location (i. e. in case of recall etc). This value will be downloaded to the POS.

electronicMarketClubs.description: Code for the marketing clubs to which the item belongs at the location. Valid values are in the code_type 'MTKC'. Examples are Baby Club (B), Baby/Family Clubs (BF) and Deli Club (D).

reportCode.description: Code to determine which reports the location should run. Values are in the code type REPC (Report Code). Examples are All Locations Reports(ALL) and  No Location Report (NO).

requiredShelfLifeOnSelection.description:
Holds the required shelf life for an item on selection in days. This field is not required. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it.

Number(4,0)

requiredShelfLifeOnReceipt.description:
Holds the required shelf life for an item on receipt in days. This field is not required. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it for processing

Number(4,0)

investmentBuyShelfLife.description:

Number(4,0)

storeReorderableInd.description: A code (Y or N) to indicate whether the store may re-order the item. Will default to N. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems.

rackSize.description: Indicates the rack size that should be used for the item. Valid values for the field are in the code_type 'RACK'. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate to external systems. Examples are large (L), Medium (M) and Small (S).

fullPalletItem.description: A code (Y or N) to indicate whether a store must reorder an item in full pallets only. Will default to N. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate to external systems.

inStoreMarketBasket.description: The in store market basket code for this item/location. Valid values for the field are in the code_type 'STMB'. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems. Examples are A item at this loc (A), B item at this loc (B) and C item at this loc (C).

storageLocation.description: Holds the current storage location or bin number for the item at the location. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it for processing.

alternateStorageLocation.description: Holds the preferred alternate storage location or bin number for the item at the location. No Merchandising processing is based on the value in this field. It is clients responsibility to communicate this value to external systems that may need it for processing

returnableInd.description: This field will contain a value of 'Y'es when the item can be returned to the location

R - Retailer
S - Supplier
If no value is provided for consignment/concession items, this will be defaulted based on the default pricing control at supplier site level.

Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 1, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 1 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inDuty.description: If Import Management is enabled in Merchandising (i. e. system_options. import_ind = Y), the inDuty flag is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in total duty.

nominationFlag3.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 3, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 3 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inExpense.description: The inExpense flag is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in total expenses.

inAlc.description: The inALC flag is used for cost components where the retailer does not expect to receive an actual value for the charge via an obligation or customs entry. The inALC flag allows the value of the cost component to be included in ALC via direct nomination and indicates to the system that the estimated value on the order should be used as the actual value as well because no other actual will be provided.

copyActivityInd.description: Indicates if the like store's closing date schedule should be copied to the new store. This value cannot be modified. It will only be populated on a store create message.

priceStore.description:
The store from which pricing information will be copied to the new store. The pricing store does not need the same currency as the new store. This value is not required on a create message and should not be populated on a modify message.

Number(10,0)

costLocation.description:
The location from which to copy cost information to the new store. This field should only be populated on store create messages. This value must be predefined on the WH or STORE table. This value cannot be modified.

Number(10,0)

vatIncludeInd.description: Indicates whether retail prices for the store will contain VAT.

vatRegion.description:
The vat region of which the store is a part. This value must be predefined on the VAT_REGION table. It is required if VAT is on in the system.

Number(4,0)

likeStore.description:
The store from which the new store will have item locations copied. This value must be predefined on the STORE table. It cannot be modified and will only be populated on a create message.

copyReplenishmentInd.description: Indicates whether replenishment information should be copied from the like store to the new store. This field cannot be modified. It will only be populated on a store create message.

transferEntity.description:
The transfer entity of which the store is a part. This value must be predefined on the TSF_ENTITY table. If the system allows intercompany transfers this field is required.

Number(10,0)

sisterStore.description:
The store which will be used to relate historical data to the new store. This value must be predefined on the STORE table.

customerId.description:

item.description: An approved, transaction level item. If a pack, it must be an orderable pack (with an order_as_type of 'P'). This is required if the ref_item field is not populated. An item/location may be added to the order in worksheet or approved status.

location.description:
An active store or warehouse. If multichannel is on, and a warehouse is being order to, a virtual warehouse is expected. An item/location may be added to the order in worksheet or approved status.

Number(10,0)

locationType.description: The location type of the location. Valid values are 'S' store and 'W' warehouse. This field cannot be modified.

unitCost.description:
The cost of the item from the supplier in the order's currency. This can be modified if the status is worksheet or approved, but not if any portion of the item's order quantity is in transit or has been received. If it is not specified on the message, it will default from the item supplier cost for this location.

Number(20,4)

referenceItem.description: The id of a reference item which can be used instead of using the item field. If the item field is not populated this field is required. A ref item/location may be added to the order in worksheet or approved status.

originCountry.description: The identifier of the country from which the item is being sourced. This field cannot be modified.

supplierPackSize.description:
The supplier pack size for the item on the order. This may be updated in worksheet or approved status.

Number(12,4)

quantityOrdered.description:
The quantity ordered of item. This can be updated in worksheet or approved status to adjust the quantity of an item/location or cancel an item/location from the order.

Number(12,4)

cancelInd.description: Indicates if the detail record's quantity should be cancelled. Valid values are 'Y'es and 'N'o.

reinstateInd.description: Indicates if a detail record which was previously cancelled should be reinstated. This will reinstate in the order quantity the amount in the cancelled bucket. Valid values are 'Y'es and 'N'o.

deliveryDate.description:
The date by which goods are to be delivered. There can be multiple item-locations on the order with different delivery dates.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

quantityCancelled.description:
This field contains the quantity that was left to be ordered when the line item was cancelled.

Number(12,4)

cancelCode.description: This field contains the reason that the line item was cancelled. This field is required if a line item is cancelled.

estimatedInstockDate.description:
Date that the item on the PO is expected to be available to ship from the PO location to another location. It is calculated as the Order Creation or Approval Date + Supplier Lead Time + Transit Days between the Supplier and the PO/location + Item/Warehouse Inbound Handling Days (if PO location is a warehouse).

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

earliestShipDate.description:
The date before which the item can not be shipped by the supplier.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

latestShipDate.description:
The date after which the item can not be shipped by the supplier.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

item.description: This field contains alphanumeric value that uniquely identifies the item.

packItem.description: This field contains alphanumeric value that uniquely identifies the pack.

location.description:
This field contains the location that item will be ordered to. This field may contain a store or a warehouse.

Number(10,0)

locationType.description: This field contains the type of location in the location field. Valid values are: S - Store W - Warehouse.

component.description: This field contains a user specified code representing a specific expense found on the ELC_COMP table.

computationValueBase.description: This field contains a code representing the base value for calculating the expense.

calculationBasis.description: This field contains the basis the expense will be calculated against if there is no CVB code attached to the expense. Valid values are S (Supplier) or O (Order). If the Cost Basis is S then when calculating the expense, the items supplier cost will be used. If the Cost Basis is O then the order unit cost of the item on the order will be used to calculate the expense. The code type for this field is EXCB.

componentRate.description:
This field contains the rate to be charged against the calculation base of the component (either value or specific).

Number(20,4)

componentCurrency.description: This field contains the currency the expense or assessment is to be entered in. If the Calculation Basis is V (Value), then comp_currency will be NULL.

exchangeRate.description:
This field contains the exchange rate of the individual expense.

Number(20,10)

perCount.description:
This field contains a count indicating the amount of the Per Count Unit of Measure to which the rate applies. When creating an expense that is defined as $. 20 for every 10 kilograms of an item ordered, the Per Count would be 10.

Number(12,4)

perCountUom.description: This field contains the unit of measure in which the Per Count is specified. When creating an expense that is defined as $. 20 for every 10 kilograms of an item ordered, the Per Count UOM would be the Unit of Measure code for Kilograms.

nominationFlag1.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 1, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 1 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inDuty.description: If Import Management is enabled in Merchandising (i. e. system_options. import_ind = Y), the inDuty flag is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in total duty.

nominationFlag3.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 3, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 3 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inExpense.description: See description for nom_flag_1. If ALC is turned on (i. e. system_options. import_ind = Y), nom_flag_2 is used to indicate the status of a component in duty calculation nom_flag_4 is used to indicate the status of a component in ELC calculation nom_flag_5 is used to indicate the status of a component in ALC calculation i. e. these 3 flags can not be used for any other purposes if ALC is turned on.

inAlc.description: See description for nom_flag_1. If ALC is turned on (i. e. system_options. import_ind = Y), nom_flag_2 is used to indicate the status of a component in duty calculation nom_flag_4 is used to indicate the status of a component in ELC calculation nom_flag_5 is used to indicate the status of a component in ALC calculation i. e. these 3 flags can not be used for any other purposes if ALC is turned on.

purchaseorder.expenses_create_Expenses.description: References the expense associated with a particular item/location of the purchase order.

orderNo.description:
The unique identifier for the order.

Number(12,0)

supplier.description:
The identifier of the supplier from which the order will be sourced. This cannot be modified if details exist for the PO.

Number(10,0)

currencyCode.description: The code of the order's currency. If not populated, the supplier's currency will be used. This field can be modified if the order status is worksheet or approved and the order has not been shipped.

terms.description: The sales terms of the order. If not populated on the create message, will default to the supplier's terms. This can be modified in worksheet or approved status.

notBeforeDate.description:
The first date that delivery will be accepted. This can be modified in worksheet or approved status.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

notAfterDate.description:
The last date that delivery will be accepted. This can be modified in worksheet or approved status.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

otbEowDate.description:
The end of week date of the OTB bucket used. This can be modified in worksheet or approved status.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

dept.description:
The department in which are all the items on the order. This field is required if the system enforces single department ordering. This cannot be modified if details exist for the PO.

Number(4,0)

status.description: The code for the status of the order. Valid values are 'W' worksheet and 'A' approved for PO creation. It is also possible to modify the status to 'C' closed.

includeOnOrderInd.description: Indicates if the order should be included in on-order calculations. This can be modified in worksheet or approved status.  Valid values are Y and N.

writtenDate.description:
The date the order was created. If this field is not populated on the message it will default to the time of creation in RMS. It cannot be modified.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

origin.description: Indicates where the order originated. Valid values include: 2 - Manual, 6 - Inventory Planning generated order, 7 , 8, 12 - Consignment Vendor Order.

ediPoInd.description: Indicates whether or not the order will be transmitted to the supplier via an Electronic Data Exchange transaction. Valid values are: Y = Submit via EDI, N = Do not use EDI.

preMarkInd.description: This field indicated whether or not a supplier has agreed to break an order into separate boxes so that the boxes can be sent directly to stores.  Valid values are Y and N.

approvedBy.description: Indicates where the order was approved. It will be the user ID of the person approving the order.

commentDesc.description: Any comments pertaining to the order.

dataLoadingDestination.description: This field indicates if the order will be created in RMS or the staging tables. Valid values are RMS or STG. If not defined, the default is STG.

masterOrderNo.description:
This field indicates the master order number from which child records were created.

Number(12,0)

ladingPort.description: This field indicates the port from which the items on the purchase order are shipped.

dischargePort.description: This field indicates the port at which the items on the purchase order will enter the country of import.

factory.description: This field indicates the factory at which the items on the purchase order are made.

agent.description: This field indicates the agent that is used in the purchase of the items on the purchase order.

shipMethod.description: This field indicates the method used to ship the items on the purchase order from the country of origin to the country of import.

partner1.description: This field indicates the Additional Partner 1.

partner2.description: This field indicates the Additional Partner 2.

partner3.description: This field indicates the Additional Partner 3.

importCountry.description: The identifier of the country into which the items on the order are being imported.

purchaseType.description: This field indicates whats included in the suppliers cost of the item. Valid values include C (Cost), CI (Cost and Insurance), CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight) and FOB (Free on Board).

paymentMethod.description: This field indicates the default method for how purchase orders for this site will be paid.  Valid values are in the code type PYMT(Payment Method). Examples are Open Account(OA), Letter of Credit(LC) and Wire Transfer(WT).

titlePassLocationType.description: Contains the code indicating the type of location or point where ownership of merchandise changes hands from seller/supplier to buyer/retailer. Valid values are found under the FOBT code type. Examples are City and State (AC), Country Of Sourcing (CA) and City (CI).

titlePassLocation.description: Contains the description of the location or point where ownership of merchandise changes hands from seller/supplier to buyer/retailer.

purchaseOrderType.description: This field contains the value associated with the PO_TYPE for the order.

orderType.description: Indicates the type of order and which Open To Buy bucket will be updated. Valid values include: N/B - Non Basic, ARB - Automatic Reorder of Basic, BRB - Buyer Reorder of Basic, DSD - Direct Store Delivery

buyer.description:
Contains the number associated with the buyer for the order.

Number(4,0)

location.description:
This field contains the location all items on the order will be delivered to if populated. i. e. It will mean a single location order.

Number(10,0)

locationType.description: This field contains the type of location in the location field. Valid values are: Valid values are S (Store) or W (Warehouse).

promotion.description:
Contains the RPCS offer ID associated with the order to provide a link between the order dialog and the promotions dialog.

Number(10,0)

qualityControlInd.description: Determines whether or not quality control will be required when items for this order are received. Valid values are Y and N.

freightTerms.description: Indicator that references what freight terms are related to the order.

backhaulType.description: This field contains the type of backhaul allowance that will be applied to the order. Some examples are Calculated or Flat rate.

backhaulAllowance.description:
This field will contain the backhaul allowance value.

Number(20,4)

shipPayMethod.description: Code indicating the payment terms for freight charges associated with the order. Valid values include: CC - Collect, CF - Collect Freight Credited Back to Customer, DF - Defined by Buyer and Seller, MX - Mixed, PC - Prepaid but Charged to Customer, PO - Prepaid Only, PP - Prepaid by Seller.

transportationResponsibilityType.description: Contains the code indicating the type of location or point at which the responsibility for transportation transfers from the seller/supplier to the buyer/retailer. Valid values are found under the FOBT code type.  Examples are City and State (AC), Country Of Sourcing (CA) and Country (CC).

transportationResponsibility.description: Contains the description of the location or point at which the responsibility for transportation transfers from the seller/supplier to the buyer/retailer.

vendorOrderNo.description: Contains the vendors unique identifying number for an order. These orders may have originated by the vendor through the EDI process or this number can be associated to a Oracle Retail order when the order is created on-line.

freightContractNo.description: The number of the contract with a shipper that will give specific freight rates. This field is only available when the system is running Import functionality.

pickupLocation.description: Contains the location at which the order will be picked up, if the order is a Pickup order.

pickupNo.description: Contains the reference number of the Pickup order.

pickupDate.description:
Contains the date when the order can be picked up from the Supplier. This field is only required if the Purchase Type of the order is Pickup.

Date Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example (2001-12-31)

appointmentDateTime.description:
This column will hold the date and time of the receiving appointment at the warehouse.

Datetime Format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z' Example (2001-12-31T23:59:59.999Z)

importType.description: Valid values are IMporter and EXporter. This is the default importer/exporter assigned to the supplier of the Puchase order.

importId.description:
This identifies the importer/exporter assigned to the supplier. This should reference the WH. WH folumn with foreign key created.

Number(10,0)

clearingZoneId.description: This column will hold the clearing zone id.

routingLocation.description: This is the default routing location for the import order. FK on OUTLOC. OUTLOC_ID.

reApproveInd.description: This field indicates that the update to the corresponding purchase order needs to be performed, and then it should be approved again.  Valid values are Y and N.

nominationFlag1.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 1, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 1 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

nominationFlag1.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 1, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 1 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inDuty.description: If Import Management is enabled in Merchandising (i. e. system_options. import_ind = Y), the inDuty flag is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in total duty.

nominationFlag3.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 3, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 3 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inExpense.description: The inExpense flag is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in total expenses.

inAlc.description: The inALC flag is used for cost components where the retailer does not expect to receive an actual value for the charge via an obligation or customs entry. The inALC flag allows the value of the cost component to be included in ALC via direct nomination and indicates to the system that the estimated value on the order should be used as the actual value as well because no other actual will be provided.

nominationFlag1.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 1, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 1 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inDuty.description: See description for nom_flag_1. If ALC is turned on (i. e. system_options. import_ind = Y), nom_flag_2 is used to indicate the status of a component in duty calculation nom_flag_4 is used to indicate the status of a component in ELC calculation nom_flag_5 is used to indicate the status of a component in ALC calculation i. e. these 3 flags can not be used for any other purposes if ALC is turned on.

nominationFlag3.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 3). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 3, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 3 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

inExpense.description: See description for nom_flag_1. perCountUom.description: This field contains the unit of measure in which the Per Count is specified. When creating an expense that is defined as $. 20 for every 10 kilograms of an item ordered, the Per Count UOM would be the Unit of Measure code for Kilograms.

nominationFlag1.description: This field contains a flag that is used to indicate if the value of the cost component should be included in the calculation of another. Nomination flags are used to calculate the value of a Computation Value Base (CVB) which has the corresponding nomination flag set to Yes (Y). Valid values are: N/A (N) (the value of this component will not be included in CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), Add (+) (the value of this component will be added to CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1), and Subtract (-) (the value of this component will be deducted from CVBs which look at Nomination Flag 1). For example, if cost component ABC has a + in Nomination Flag 1, then all CVBs that include Nomination Flag 1 will include this cost component value in their calculation basis.

ediOrderInd.description: Indicates whether or not the order will be transmitted to the supplier via an Electronic Data Exchange transaction. Valid values are: Y = Submit via EDI, N = Do not use EDI.

importOrderInd.description: Indicates if the purchase order is an import order. Valid values are Y (Yes) and N (No).

importCountryId.description: The identifier of the country into which the items on the order are being imported.

poType.description: Contains the value associated with the PO_TYPE for the order. Valid values are in the PO_TYPE table.

backhaulAllowance.description:

pickupLocation.description: This field contains the location at which the order will be picked up, if the order is a Pickup order.

pickupNo.description: This field contains the reference number of the pickup order.

purchaseType.description: This field indicates what is included in the supplier's cost of the item.

rejectCode.description: Contains a code for the reason why the order was rejected during the automatic replenishment approval process. Valid values include: VM (Vendor minimum not met), NC (Negative cost calculated on an item), UOM (UOM convert error due to incomplete data).

shipMethod.description: The method used to ship the items on the purchase order from the country of origin to the country of import.

shipPayMethod.description: Code indicating the payment terms for freight charges associated with the order. Valid values include: CC - Collect, CF - Collect Freight Credited Back to Customer, DF - Defined by Buyer and Seller, MX - Mixed, PC - Prepaid but Charged to Customer, PO - Prepaid Only, PP - Prepaid by Seller.

splitRefOrderNo.description:
This column will store the original order number from which the split orders were generated. It will be for reference purposes only.

NUMBER(12,0)

vendorOrderNo.description: This field contains the vendor's unique identifying number for an order. These orders may have originated by the vendor through the EDI process, or this number can be associated with an Oracle Retail order when the order is created on-line.

promotion.description:
Contains the ad number associated with the order to provide a link between the order dialog and the promotions dialog.

NUMBER(10,0)

terms.description: This field is an indicator identifying the sales terms for the order. These terms specify when payment is due and if any discounts exist for early payment.

freightTerms.description: This field is an indicator that references what freight terms are related to the order.

fobTransactionResponsibility.description: Contains the code indicating the type of the location that is responsible for the transportation of the order.

agent.description: This field contains the agent that is used in the purchase of the items on the purchase order. This field is only available when the system is running Import functionality.

dischargePort.description: This field contains the port at which the items on the purchase order will enter the country of import. This field is only available when the system is running Import functionality.

dischargePortDescription.description: This field contains the description of the discharge port.

ladingPort.description: This field contains the port from which the items on the purchase order are shipped. This field is only available when the system is running Import functionality.

ladingPortDescription.description: This field contains the description of the lading port.

freightContractNo.description: This field contains the number of the contract with a shipper that will give specific freight rates. This field is only available when the system is running Import functionality.

poType.description: This field contains the value associated with the PO_TYPE for the order. Valid values are in the PO_TYPE table.

poTypeDescription.description: This field contains the description of the PO type.

preMarkInd.description: This field indicates whether or not a supplier has agreed to break an order into separate boxes so that the boxes can be sent directly to stores.

currencyCode.description: This field contains the currency code for the order. When creating an order within Merchandising, this field will always default to the currency of the supplier, but it can be overwritten.

contractNo.description:
This field contains the contract number associated with this order.

NUMBER(6,0)

pickupLocation.description: This field contains the location at which the order will be picked up, if the order is a pickup order.

pickupNo.description: This field contains the reference number for the pickup order.

pickupDate.description: This field contains the date when the order can be picked up from the supplier. This field is only required if the purchase type of the order is Pickup.

appointmentDatetime.description: This field contains the date of the receiving appointment at the warehouse.

comments.description: This field contains the miscellaneous comments attached to the purchase order.

writtenDate.description: This field specifies the date the order was created within the system.

orderOriginatedInd.description:
This field indicates where the order originated.

NUMBER(2,0)

originalApprovalDate.description: This field specifies the date that the order was originally approved.

originalApprovalId.description: This field indicates where the order was approved. It will be the user ID of the person approving the order for all orders manually approved online and will contain Replen for orders automatically approved in the replenishment process.

ediSentInd.description: This field indicates whether or not the order has been sent via EDI.

ediOrderInd.description: This field indicates whether or not the order will be transmitted to the supplier via an Electronic Data Exchange transaction.

importOrderInd.description: This field indicates if the purchase order is an import order.

importCountryId.description: This field specifies the identifier of the country into which the items on the order are being imported.

importType.description: This field specifies the importer/exporter assigned to the supplier of the purchase order.

importId.description:
This field identifies the importer/exporter assigned to the supplier. This should reference the WH.WH column.

NUMBER(10,0)

clearingZoneId.description: This field contains the clearing zone ID.

routingLocationId.description: This field contains the routing location for the import order.

deliverySupplier.description:
This field holds the supplier or supplier site from where the goods are delivered.

NUMBER(10,0)

wfOrderNo.description:
This field contains the franchise order number for which the purchase order was created.

NUMBER(10,0)

exchangeRateInd.description: This field contains the exchange rate indicator on a document.

customerOrderNo.description: This field holds the master customer order number from the Order Management System.

fullfillmentOrderNo.description: This field holds the number from the Order Management System (OMS) related to the fulfillment details. One or more fulfillment orders could relate back to a single customer order in OMS.

customerOrderInd.description: This field indicates whether the purchase order is linked to a customer order.

createDateTime.description: This column holds the record creation date and time (UTC).

updateDateTime.description: This column holds the date and time when the record was last updated (UTC).

customFlexAttribute.description: This list holds custom flex attributes for the purchase order.

details.description: This list holds details for the purchase order.

item.description: This field contains the unique alphanumeric value to identify the item included in the purchase order.

referenceItem.description: This field contains the unique alphanumeric value to identify the reference item.

physicalLocationType.description: This field contains the type of location in the location field.

physicalLocation.description:
This field contains the actual physical location that the item will be ordered to. This field may contain a store or a physical warehouse.

NUMBER(10,0)

virtualWarehouse.description:
This field contains the virtual warehouse for the order location when the physical location type is warehouse.

NUMBER(10,0)

physicalStoreType.description: This field indicates the store type of the physical location store. This is only populated if physical location type is store.

physicalStockholdingInd.description: This field indicates whether the physical location store is stockholding or not.

physicalQuantityOrdered.description:
This field indicates the total quantity ordered to the physical location.

NUMBER(12,4)

unitCost.description:
This field contains the unit cost for the item/location on the order, including discounts (deal/bracket/allowance), but not landed cost components. This field is stored in order currency.

NUMBER(20,4)

supplierInitialUnitCost.description:
Initial supplier unit cost of the item/location on the order, before deals were applied. When discounts must be recalculated on an approved order, this cost will be used as the starting point. This value is captured as the current item/location/supplier/origin country cost at the time of order approval.

NUMBER(20,4)

unitRetail.description:
This field contains the current retail price in local currency for the SKU at this location.

NUMBER(20,4)

prescaledQuantity.description:
This field contains the order quantity (system generated or manually generated) for the item/location before order scaling processing was performed.

NUMBER(12,4)

originalReplenishmentQuantity.description:
This field contains the original order quantity generated by the replenishment process.

NUMBER(12,4)

costSource.description: This field indicates the basis for the cost of the item/location on the order and whether deals or brackets have been applied.

lastRoundedQuantity.description:
This field holds the most recent system rounded order quantity value for the line item.

NUMBER(12,4)

lastGroupRoundedQuantity.description:
This field holds the last system rounded order quantity for the rounding group the location is a part of.

NUMBER(12,4)

originCountryId.description: This field contains the identifier of the country from which the item is being sourced.

supplierPackSize.description:
This field contains the supplier pack size for this order/item.

NUMBER(12,4)

earliestShipDate.description: This field contains the earliest date that the item can be shipped by the supplier.

latestShipDate.description: This field contains the date after which the item can not be shipped by the supplier.

pickupLocation.description: This field contains the location at which the order will be picked up, if the order is a pickup order.

pickupNo.description: This field is not used in Merchandising.

packingMethod.description: This field indicates whether the packing method of the item in the container is flat or hanging. Valid values are defined under code type PKMT.

roundLevel.description: This field will be used to determine how order quantities will be rounded to case, layer, and pallet.

transferOrderLinkId.description:
This field contains a reference number to link the item on the transfer to any purchase orders that have been created to allow the from location (i.e. warehouse) on the transfer to fulfill the transfer quantity to the to location (i.e. store) on the transfer.

NUMBER(12,0)

estimatedInStockDate.description: This field contains the date that the item on the PO is expected to be available to ship from the PO location to another location.

transactionUom.description: This field holds the original transaction unit of measure to be passed on to the store system. It is only used for customer direct orders coming from the order management system. All quantities on the payload are expressed in the item's standard unit of measure.

itemLineNo.description:
This field indicates the item line number from customer orders.

NUMBER(10,0)

orderItemCreateDateTime.description: This column holds the record order detail item creation date and time (UTC).

orderItemUpdateDateTime.description: This column holds the date and time when the order detail item was last updated (UTC).

orderItemLocCreateDateTime.description: This column holds the record order detail item location creation date and time (UTC).

orderItemLocUpdateDateTime.description: This column holds the date and time when the order detail item location was last updated (UTC).

orderItemCustomFlexAttribute.description: This list holds custom flex attributes for purchase order item details.

orderItemLocationCustomFlexAttribute.description: This list holds custom flex attributes for purchase order item location details.

OrderDetails.description: This list holds details for the purchase order.

hasMore.description: Boolean to signify if there are additional pages of data. This is true if limit = count for pagination supported request

limit.description: Requested page size. If the page size was not defined in the input request, a default page size is used to limit the number of records to fetch

count.description: Number of record in the response object

links.description: List of Self and/or Next URL
